subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result visibility policy should this PR implement for DeepSeek prefix-cache preservation?
rationale: The branch changes what the model can see after tool calls, and code review can reject the broad allowlist but cannot choose the permanent product rule for heartbeat, session, web, memory, read, and exec outputs.

options.title: Define a typed narrow policy
options.body: Retarget the patch to current packages/ai code, preserve core tool outputs by default, and only summarize maintainer-approved ephemeral results with tests and live proof.

options.title: Limit to heartbeat/session status
options.body: Accept a smaller mitigation for low-value status tools while leaving read, exec, web, and memory outputs visible until a fuller policy is designed.

options.title: Choose another cache strategy
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the boundary-aware cache work or isolated heartbeat sessions over provider-layer result summarization.

recommendation.title: Define a typed narrow policy
recommendation.body: Retarget the patch to current packages/ai code, preserve core tool outputs by default, and only summarize maintainer-approved ephemeral results with tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest history signal for provider conversion and prompt-cache boundary behavior touched by this decision.
